AI Engineer — production LLM systems

I build and operate production LLM systems: multi-agent orchestration, RAG, evaluation, and guardrails. Physicist by training, then two decades building software and leading engineering teams — 500+ apps shipped, 10M+ downloads — now building AI systems hands-on.

I started out writing C++ simulations for CERN's LHC experiments, spent more than 20 years building software and leading engineering teams, and in 2025 rebuilt my delivery operation around AI — running an LLM-orchestrated pipeline solo, from design through release. Most of the work is the verification and eval that keeps quality up at volume: generation isn't the bottleneck, verification is.

Who I am — a 5-min intro. I walk through the three questions an AI-engineering screen usually opens with: ① 20 years in software, the last two on AI · ② my most recent public project, Strata-RAG (retrieval + evaluation) · ③ my strongest languages and stack.
